J. K. Rowling wrote the Harry Potter ser.why: The first sentence of the Harry Potter article, and one of the most repeated facts in literature.

sources.quote: Harry Potter is a series of seven children's fantasy novels written by British author J. K. Rowling.

Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart composed the ope.why: Deliberately false so the disjunction turns on the removed property: Carmen is by Georges Bizet.

sources.quote: Carmen (French: [kaʁmɛn] ) is an opera in four acts by the French composer Georges Bizet.

The Fellowship of the Ring comes earlier.why: Both links are true: the three volumes appear in this order on every edition and listing. People list the volumes in order; nobody writes out that the first comes before the third.

sources.quote: The Two Towers, first published in 1954, is the second volume of J. R. R. Tolkien's high fantasy novel The Lord of the Rings. It is preceded by The Fellowship of the Ring and followed by The Return of the King.
The Return of the King is the third and final volume of J. R. R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings, following The Fellowship of the Ring and The Two Towers.

sources.query: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Two Towers and The Return of the King
The Fellowship of the Ring comes earlier in The Lord of the Rings than The Return of the King
The Fellowship of the Ring comes before The Return of the King

Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone.why: Both links are true: the books are numbered 1, 4 and 7. The conclusion about books one and seven is never written as a sentence; people give the numbers.

sources.quote: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire is a fantasy novel by British author J. K. Rowling. It is the fourth novel in the Harry Potter series.

Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone comes before Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
Goblet of Fire is the fourth book

notes: Pair of literature_arts-replace-0009: removes the original fact, that 'comes earlier in the same series than' is transitive. Real series stand in for the revision's made-up ones: every instance gives both links in the prompt and asks whether the conclusion follows, so each becomes "does not know" (strong Kleene gives the same for the propositional queries). Residual risk: a model may keep the order of famous series from stored knowledge or from the meaning of 'earlier'; a "yes" is then a kept property or a route around it. The conclusions are counted in the corpus (expected near zero).
